d:
Tere jaisa yar kahan philm yarana ka ek sadabhar dosti git hai, jise mahan gayak kishor kumar ne apni dil chhu lene vali aavaz men gaya hai. is git men amitabh bachchan ki shandar adakari aur sachchi dosti ki bhavna ko khubsurti se darshaya gaya hai.
Agar aapko 80 ke dashak ke evragrin hindi gane, amitabh bachchan ke suparhit git aur kishor kumar ki sadabhar aavaz pasand hai, to is git ko pura dekhen, laik karen, sheyar karen aur hamare chainal ko sabsakraib karna na bhulen.
git: tere jaisa yar kahan
philm: yarana
gayak: kishor kumar
mukhy kalakar: amitabh bachchan
